notes: The street grid turns here: 8th, 7th and L'Hommedieu run due east from Mound and bend to ENE about x~1050; George and 6th are already ENE; Smith and John run SSE (dx/dy ~0.3). John jogs at West 7th: John north of 7th (40 ft, centre x~2934 at y1500) meets 7th at (2971,1625); John south of 7th (40 ft; NOT 60 - the 60' near the junction labels 7th) is offset ~185 px east along 7th and meets it at (3150,1572); both are T junctions, and the southern part is named 'John Street (south of 7th)' for all its points so the two lines stay separate. The street called '?' on sheet 41 (12 ft, from Mound east) is L'Hommedieu: printed 'L'HOMMEDIEU' on the segment between Mound and Smith (12' printed at Mound; it widens to ~19 ft further east, and a second width label at the bend is not readable), and 'ALLEY' on the segment east of Smith, which continues across John onto sheet 43 where it is again printed L'HOMMEDIEU; recorded everywhere as 'L'Hommedieu Alley'. Mound is 47' north of 8th and 60' south of it (centre 633 north, 610 south; point is the middle of the four corners). Van Horne, Barr and Kenyon come from the west and end at Mound (T); George comes from the east and ends at Mound (T). Mound/West 6th is offset: the northern part (60 ft, centre ~742 at y3870) meets the 6th centreline at (751,3985); the part south of 6th (50', runs SSE dx/dy ~0.29) meets it at (791,3973); the point given is the midpoint (same treatment as sheet 41). Smith runs from 7th (T, block north of 7th unbroken) south across 6th. West 8th and West 7th centres from both faces; West 6th 66' with both faces drawn east of Mound. NAMING: Barr and Kenyon here are the pieces that jog at Cutter (sheets 40-41) and run only Cutter to Mound, so they carry the names 'Barr Street (east of Cutter)' and 'Kenyon Avenue (east of Cutter)' used on sheets 40-41.
